reason: Current evidence supports scoped answer-production effects but not query-adaptive semantic relevance or retention; narrowing versus new mechanism evidence is a substantive user choice.

routes.A: Narrow scoped manuscript after a read-only interface audit; no automatic model runs.
routes.B: Preregister source-span and latent-retention validation before considering any redesign or inference campaign.

reflection.what_worked: Matched M3 comparison plus reproducible M4 offline audits separate selection, candidate validity and correctness.
reflection.what_failed: Query-varying scores did not produce varying selections; source metadata did not supply verified semantic labels.
reflection.learned_constraints: Five contexts only; historical dirty P7 cannot be merged with current M3; candidate validity is not parser failure or semantic retrieval.

next_direction.objective: User chooses scoped writing versus obtaining new mechanism evidence.
key_steps: Plan the chosen stage with explicit evidence and approval gates
abandonment_criteria: Do not infer a route or launch experiments without the required authorization
